note_on_spec_precedence: Override any 'independent RIGHT sidebar / permanent right-side holding column' proposal in old design/art candidate. User explicitly wants unplaced animals distributed on BOTH SIDES of the board, not an exclusive RIGHT holding bar. This remains a provisional responsive layout to be visually reviewed, not a claim of final UI G3.
goal: Use already-working code and user-approved panda PNG to implement a playable, responsive first-chapter UI runtime slice before final background arrives. Build layout/flow now while ART finishes isolated background and visual review in parallel.

visually_approved_reference.limitation: Baked board and level label, unsuitable as directly layered runtime environment. No final G3 isolated-background approval.

execution_plan.scope: Build layout and complete prototype-level flow using existing 3 levels and approved panda, with placeholder or simple programmatic background; no dependence on isolated art file.

When exact separate environment PNG is approved and genuinely accessible from verified local path, import by original bytes/hash, apply as low-noise behind-the-board background, keep UI/grid/buttons programmatic; test and sync to GitHub.

required_behavior: Keep existing multigrid placement/rotation engine, existing real approved panda PNG and user-passed grab-point and rollback behavior; do not rewrite basic gameplay for UI styling.

Arrange unplaced animals around the LEFT and RIGHT sides of the board, distributed/balanced, NOT one permanent dedicated right-hand pending tray. Overflow may scroll within available side regions, with all pieces reachable.
Board remains primary focus. Header/progress, board, both animal staging regions and controls must be non-overlapping, no art/UI collision.
Layout responds to real w/h, piece counts and rotated bounding boxes; eliminate fixed board/tray Y and fixed '3 levels' strings.
Adapt to desktop 1280x720, 1024x768, 800x600; 3x2, 5x2, 4x3 real existing levels and 6x5/6-piece layout stress fixture (not official 4th level).
Keep pointer grab offset stable during rotation, full-piece visual ghost/preview, legal/illegal feedback not only by color, invalid operation rollback, placed pieces retrievable to side staging area.

Add functional START, light tutorial cues, PLAY, LEVEL_COMPLETE, CHAPTER_COMPLETE and REPLAY within existing HTML/Canvas. Progress comes from levels.length; do not hardcode 8/15 or issue formal content size assertions.
Keep accessible text actions for rotate, reset/recover; implement undo only if gameplay testing shows reset/reposition insufficient and approved within scope.
Use style placeholders until exact isolated art version approved; do not use baked board/level-title source as a runtime background, do not crop/regenerate/retouch the G3-approved panda.
not_in_scope: New animal generation, new official puzzle levels or freezing 8/5 content candidates
Full final UI visual G3 approval, marketing art, title logo polish, custom animation engine
Changing current V1.4 contract or re-opening old GPT development Owner
Recreating reference game's original UI, levels, program or assets
Claiming full release G4/G1 from existing 3-level tests
Waiting or polling repeatedly for background if separate PNG is not available; code independent UI now and keep background integration as explicit blocker
implementation_acceptance: Existing 3 playable levels pass actual pointer/keyboard click-through start-to-chapter-end and restart in browser using approved original panda source bytes
Responsiveness check includes 1280x720/1024x768/800x600 and smallest/largest board fixture; no overlap/clip or inaccessible UI/pieces
At least one invalid drop/rotation, retrieval, cancellation, resize during play, next and restart regression test with no JavaScript page errors
UI no longer relies on boardY=40/trayY=405 as globally fixed functional layout assumptions
Baked background not silently treated as approved game asset; app remains playable with fallback background
Evidence: exact commands, screenshots at representative desktop dimensions, result JSON, current Git commit and limitations; CI optional if already supported, no new huge pipeline
Handoff distinctly records A code status, B art dependency and whether unmodified PNG bytes were verified/read back
Do not label 'RELEASE_READY' until independent G1-G4 scope is actually met

output.implementation_location: Reuse experiments/panda_v2/ unless a very small clearly explained boundary is needed
output.git_policy: Single scoped code/evidence PR or commits on existing main branch following existing Codex repo rules; no duplicate engines.

blocking_dependency.condition: Exact revised isolated environment PNG visually approved by HUMAN, original byte file actually reaches local Codex or GitHub and SHA256 checks pass
blocking_dependency.blocks: Background finalization only, NOT dynamic layout implementation

decisions.user_current_request: May Codex start now that first background candidate is visually completed? yes, technical UI work can start immediately.

next_owner_action: Codex reads V1.4, this request, current code and real approved panda metadata; executes step A autonomously, tests and commits evidence, reports step B only when art G3/bytes available.
